title: Grateful Dead Live at The Ark on 1969-04-23
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Very good soundboard recording with minor speed glitches, complemented by an excellent performance
ai_review.review: The tape sounds generally clear and well‑balanced, though a few sections exhibit slight slow‑down likely from heat‑ or moisture‑damage on the original reel. Despite these technical quirks the band delivered an outstanding show that night, earning high praise from listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: A single detailed 5‑star review highlights an excellent performance (high show weight) and overall good soundboard quality despite minor speed issues (moderate recording weight).

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall mix, but occasional tape‑speed fluctuations suggest heat/moisture damage; minimal ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers note the performance was uniformly excellent.
